updates.research_question: HM先筛参数空间再用ABC能否减少计算，同时如何改变不确定性/真值覆盖及经验结构选择？
updates.mechanisms: HM truncated support;uniform informed ABC prior;observation/ensemble/discrepancy decomposition
updates.findings: HM+ABC narrows intervals and reduces reported simulation runs;synthetic coverage declines in91 retained designs;RISC historical fit within16 structures,not unique causal identification
